title: Presentation Slide Url Sync
summary:
Presentation URLs now track the active slide and carry a bookmark-only slide name.

- Core: added `PresentationSlideRef`, `collectPresentationSlides`, `presentationSlideAt`, `formatPresentationSlideHash`, and `parsePresentationSlideHash`.
- React renderer: slide URL sync is on by default (`hash !== false`); on each slide change writes reveal.js hash plus `?name=<arrangementId>`. The `name` query param is never read for navigation (hash alone drives slide position).
- Projektetage deck uses default URL sync (removed `hash: false`).

Verified live on localhost:6050 — navigating updates URL like `?name=description#/0/1`. All 31 core and 17 renderer tests pass.
